Job Description The Production Network Engineer is responsible for ensuring the availability, performance, and security of the network infrastructures of multiple customers within a shared services team. He/She operates and maintains LAN/WAN, datacenter and security components in a 24/7 production environment, handles complex incidents (L2/L3), and implements changes and upgrades. Responsibilities Operations & Monitoring: Ensure proper functioning of LAN/WAN/WLAN, datacenter networks, and customer interconnections. Monitor network devices (switches, routers, firewalls, VPN, proxies, load balancers) and manage alerts through diagnosis, prioritization, resolution, or escalation. Incident Management (L2/L3): Take ownership of complex incidents, perform advanced troubleshooting (logs, packet captures, traces), and communicate progress to internal teams and customers. Fluent in English; comfortable with technical English. Able to prioritize, work autonomously, and perform under on‑call conditions. Technical Skills IP Networking: Solid knowledge of TCP/IP, VLANs, routing (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP), switching (STP, RSTP, VXLAN), QoS, HSRP/VRRP, link aggregation. Infrastructure: Experience with Cisco, Juniper, Aruba, HP; WAN (MPLS, IPsec VPN, SD‑WAN); enterprise Wi‑Fi environments. Security: Firewalls (ASA/FTD, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point), VPNs, proxies; concepts like segmentation, DMZ, NAC, bastion hosts. Tools: Monitoring tools (Zabbix, PRTG), ticketing (ServiceNow), config management (Git, Ansible). Systems: Good understanding of Linux/Windows servers and core services (DNS, DHCP, NTP). Knowledge of datacenter/virtualization (VMware, Nutanix, hypervisors, F5/Citrix load balancers). Soft Skills Rigorous, responsible, reliable—especially in production and on‑call environments. Strong analytical thinking; remains calm and reactive during crises. Team‑oriented mindset in multi‑customer environments. Organized, autonomous, and able to manage priorities effectively. Customer‑focused with respect for SLAs and deadlines.

review_candidates.title: VP, Data Center Operations
review_candidates.description: Flexential is seeking a proven, enterprise scale operations leader to serve as Vice President, Data Center Operations . Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, this executive will lead the performance, discipline, and daily execution of a national portfolio of 40+ mission critical multi-tenant and wholesale data centers and a team of 300+ people. The role carries broad accountability for regional operations, critical environment performance, physical security, environmental health and safety, and the leadership of teams responsible for operating highly reliable data center infrastructure in support of customer workloads. This leader will own the operational heartbeat of the portfolio. The Vice President will be responsible for ensuring that every facility is run with rigor, consistency, technical depth, and a relentless commitment to uptime, safety, and customer confidence. The scope is highly centered on mission critical execution and requires deep command of MEP systems, critical power and cooling infrastructure, maintenance discipline, operational readiness, and incident leadership. The role is designed for a leader who is energized by scale, complexity, and the opportunity to build. This executive will inherit a meaningful operating footprint and will be expected to elevate performance, strengthen leadership capability, drive consistency across regions, and create an environment in which high standards are translated into repeatable, measurable results. For the right candidate, this is an opportunity to make a visible enterprise impact and help define the future operating model of a rapidly evolving digital infrastructure platform. Why This Role Matters Flexential’s data center portfolio sits at the center of critical customer operations. As the business continues to scale, the company requires a senior operations executive who can bring strong field credibility, strategic thinking, disciplined execution, and the ability to lead through complexity. The Vice President, Data Center Operations will play a central role in ensuring that facilities perform safely and consistently, that teams are equipped and aligned, and that the operating model can support continued growth with confidence. This is not a staff or advisory role. It is an operating role in the truest sense. The leader in this position will be accountable for what happens in the field, how teams perform, how incidents are led, how risk is managed, and how the company turns institutional standards, insights, and operational expectations into world class execution. Role Scope and Organizational Context The Vice President, Data Center Operations owns the “run” component of the company’s operating model. The role is accountable for executing within the framework established by enterprise partners responsible for standards, training, operational enablement, controls, and intelligence. This position is therefore best suited for a leader who understands how to partner closely across functions, consume and operationalize enterprise guidance effectively, and hold field teams accountable for disciplined adoption and execution. The role is distinct from groups that create standards, training content, controls platforms, or operational intelligence. Instead, the Vice President ensures that these inputs are translated into performance at the site and regional level. This clear separation of responsibilities is intentional and creates the conditions for sharper accountability, stronger execution, and better enterprise alignment. Key Responsibilities Enterprise Data Center Operations Leadership Lead all day-to-day operations across the company’s data center portfolio, with accountability for execution, reliability, workforce performance, and site level discipline. Provide leadership to regional operations leaders and site teams, establishing clear expectations, strong operating rhythms, and visible accountability for performance. Drive consistency across facilities while preserving appropriate agility to respond to local operational realities, customer needs, and evolving business priorities. Build a performance culture rooted in safety, ownership, responsiveness, preparation, and continuous improvement. Drive rigorous maintenance, data quality, and operational adoption of DCIM, BMS, building automation, and controls platforms to strengthen visibility, standardize execution, and improve portfolio performance. Critical Facility, Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing Leadership Own the operational performance and lifecycle review of mission critical facility infrastructure, including electrical, mechanical, plumbing, cooling, life safety, critical power, generation, UPS, switchgear, and supporting systems required to sustain uptime and customer confidence. Ensure strong maintenance discipline, technical readiness, facility inspections, incident preparedness, and operational rigor across all sites. Lead with credibility in highly technical, MEP intensive environments where precision, sound judgment, and operational discipline are essential. Safety, Security, and Risk Management Provide executive oversight for Environmental Health and Safety programs across the operations organization. Lead physical security operations and reinforce disciplined execution of site access, life safety, and risk management protocols. Promote a culture in which safety and risk awareness are foundational to every operating decision and every level of the organization. Operational Execution of Enterprise Standards Translate enterprise standards, training, reporting, operational intelligence, and controls related insights into high-quality execution across the field organization. Ensure teams understand expectations, adopt the required operating practices, and meet the company’s standards for consistency and performance. Create strong follow through mechanisms, so operational policies and expectations are not only communicated, but fully implemented and sustained. Cross Functional Leadership Partner closely with teams responsible for construction, commissioning, operational enablement, controls, analytics, and process improvement to ensure clean handoffs, strong readiness, and effective execution across the portfolio. Provide field informed feedback that strengthens how future capacity is delivered, how standards are matured, and how enterprise systems better support operations at scale. Act as a trusted enterprise leader who can balance collaboration with clarity of ownership and execution accountability. Talent and Organizational Development Build, coach, and develop a high performing operations leadership team capable of leading at scale. Strengthen bench depth, succession planning, and leadership capability across regions and sites. Attract and retain strong talent by creating a demanding, mission driven, and highly respected operations culture. Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is an experienced mission critical operations executive who combines technical credibility with strong people leadership and enterprise level judgment. This individual will bring a deep understanding of facility operations and MEP systems, along with a demonstrated ability to lead across geographies, improve consistency, strengthen culture, and raise the performance of complex operating teams. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable in executive discussions and field environments. They will know how to lead during incidents, how to build trust with experienced operators, how to make difficult decisions with confidence, and how to create alignment across functions without losing sight of accountability. They will be energized by the opportunity to shape an organization, elevate standards of performance, and leave a durable mark on the operating model. Required Qualifications Ten or more years of progressive leadership experience in mission critical operations, industrial operations, or similarly complex environments where uptime, safety, and technical discipline are paramount. Significant experience leading multi site operations teams with accountability for performance across multiple geographies. Deep expertise in data center or similarly critical mechanical, electrical, and plumbing intensive environments. Demonstrated success improving operational consistency, workforce performance, reliability, and execution quality at scale. Experience leading through incidents, elevated operational risk, and periods of organizational growth or transformation. Strong command of safety, compliance, physical security, and risk management principles in operational settings. Excellent executive communication skills, strong judgment, and the ability to influence across functions and levels. Preferred Qualifications Direct experience within colocation, enterprise, wholesale, multi-tenant data center, or other mission critical infrastructure environments. Experience partnering with controls, building automation, DCIM, or operational intelligence teams in support of portfolio performance. Experience supporting new market expansion, major facility commissioning, or large-scale infrastructure growth. A track record of building strong regional leadership teams and advancing operational leadership capability over time. Measures of Success Success in this role will be measured by sustained improvement in safety performance, uptime and reliability, maintenance quality, operational readiness, incident effectiveness, site level consistency, and the strength and engagement of the operations leadership team. The Vice President will also be evaluated on their ability to build strong partnerships across the enterprise, translate standards into execution, and create a high confidence operating environment that can scale with the business. Opportunity Statement This role offers the opportunity to lead one of the most important functions in the company. It is a chance to operate at meaningful scale, influence enterprise performance, shape a critical leadership team, and build the systems, rigor, and culture required to support long term growth. For a candidate who thrives in mission critical environments and wants the chance to lead from the front, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact. Compensation Base Pay Range: Annualized salary range offered for this position is estimated to be $225,000 - $290,000 . However, the actual pay range depends on each candidate’s experience, location, and qualifications. Variable Pay: Discretionary annual bonus, based on personal and company performance. At Flexential, we value diversity and believe that different perspectives and unique skills make us stronger as a team. While we've outlined the qualities and skills we are looking for in this job posting, we understand that there may be attributes and abilities that aren't explicitly listed but could be a perfect fit for our team. We want to emphasize that you shouldn't hesitate to apply if you don't meet every requirement. We're enthusiastic about assembling a diverse team of individuals who bring various talents to the table. Your unique perspective and abilities may be just what we need to drive innovation and success. If you believe you have what it takes to thrive in our environment, we encourage you to apply. Benefits Of Working At Flexential Medical, Telehealth, Dental and Vision 401(k) Health Savings Accounts (HSA) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) Life and AD&D Short Term and Long-Term disability Flex Paid Time Off (PTO) Leave of Absence Employee Assistance Program Wellness Program Rewards and Recognition Program Benefits Benefits are subject to change at the Company's discretion. Work Location Eligibility At this time, we are only able to employ individuals who reside and perform work in states where the company is authorized to do business and maintain employment registrations. We are currently unable to consider applicants who reside or will perform work in the following states: Arkansas, Alaska, Alabama, Delaware, Hawaii, Iowa, Kansas, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, North Dakota, Rhode Island, South Dakota, Wisconsin, Wyoming, Washington DC. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States and must reside in a state where the company maintains employment eligibility at the time of hire and throughout their employment. State eligibility may be subject to change based on business needs and regulatory requirements. Flexential participates in the E-Verify program. Please click here for more information. review_candidates.title: Senior DevEx Engineer - Infrastructure
review_candidates.description: An Introduction to Primer Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform. Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on. Watch our showcase > Read up on our $100m Series C Learn more about our culture > Which team will you be joining? You'll join Infrastructure, the team that owns the platform every other Primer engineer builds and ships on. CI/CD, deployment, internal tooling, ephemeral environments: if it's how code gets from a laptop to production safely, it's ours. We operate the way the rest of Primer does. Remote-first, async, high autonomy, low bureaucracy. You build it, you own it, and that includes running it in production. You'll report to the Engineering Manager for Infrastructure & Data and work alongside a small group of senior infrastructure engineers. What makes this interesting right now is the human-AI development loop. Coding agents are changing how software gets built, and we want someone to own how that actually works at Primer rather than bolting it on. That part of the role is yours to define. What will you be doing? Own Primer's internal developer platform end to end: the CI/CD pipelines, deployment workflows (canary, blue/green), self-service tooling and ephemeral environments that every engineer here depends on to ship. Build the human-AI development loop. This is the most open part of the role: the tooling and automation that let engineers work effectively alongside coding agents, and the patterns that make agent-driven workflows fast and safe at Primer. Treat developer productivity as a measurable system. Instrument it, find where delivery actually slows down, and ship the changes that fix it instead of guessing. Take real operational ownership. You'll join the Core Infrastructure on-call rotation and own the reliability of what you build. Set the technical direction for how Primer's engineers build and ship, and bring less experienced engineers along with you as you do it. Improve how engineers write code, not just how they ship it. Partner with product teams to make the tools, frameworks and internal APIs they use everyday more ergonomic, and help reduce the friction of building features at Primer. Build Primers paved roads. Reduce the application boilerplate engineers write, shape standards around how services are built and configured, and own the golden-path tooling that lifts efficiency across every team. Work in the open across a fully distributed team, making your decisions and trade-offs visible rather than holding them in your head. What We're Looking For Strong cloud infrastructure experience. AWS is preferred; we'll also consider strong GCP backgrounds. Hands-on Kubernetes experience. Infrastructure-as-code as a working tool, not a buzzword. Terraform is preferred, but Pulumi, CloudFormation, Ansible or similar are fine. Not having Terraform specifically is not a blocker. CI/CD as a core competency. You've owned the build, test and deploy workflow and preview environments, not just used them. A history of measuring and improving delivery, using DORA, SPACE or a similar framework to back the work up. Comfortable owning production systems and being part of an on-call rotation. A genuine software engineering background. You've built and maintained applications or products, not just infrastructure tooling. You can reason about what makes code pleasant to work with. This is what lets you build AI and developer tooling that engineers actually want to use. An async-first communicator who works well in a remote, distributed team. Nice To Have Hands-on experience building with AI or agent tooling, or working directly with LLM-based development workflows. This field is new, so real curiosity counts alongside real experience. Familiarity with MCP servers and agent integration patterns. Payments, fintech or other regulated-industry experience. You may not like it here We're remote-first and async-first. Nobody is looking over your shoulder, and nobody is going to hand you tightly scoped tasks. You own your work from problem to production. This role carries real operational weight. You're on call for what you build, and when something breaks at an awkward hour, that's yours too. The AI-enablement side of this is genuinely undefined. There's no playbook yet. If you want a clear, settled remit, this isn't it. If you want to write one, it is. Pace and ambiguity are constant. Priorities shift as we learn, and you'll often be making calls without complete information. ✅ A typical interview process An initial intro call with a Talent Partner An interview with the Hiring Manager Challenge Stage - Contextualised to the role A final, values-alignment interview What's the culture like at Primer? We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants. We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities. The work is challenging. Scaleups are a challenge, and building category-defining products is a challenge. But there's a meaningful difference between a challenge and a struggle. At Primer, the right challenge comes with the right support: strong onboarding, a collaborative environment, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. It's never something you face alone. Our benefits 🌍 We are fully remote and globally distributed; and have been since day one 💰 Competitive share options 🌴 Uncapped holiday, with 25 days minimum to be taken 🗣️ Co-working space access across major cities 📅 Workations & Company Retreat 💻 The best equipment for your role 🏠 £500 towards your home office setup 🔎 Generous learning budget 🏥 Private Medical Insurance 📈 A broad set of additional perks and benefits ( depending on location) Don’t meet every single requirement?
